stories.title: Bitcoin-backed loans let holders borrow without selling — but there's a catch
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that Bitcoin holders can borrow against their coins without selling them, but flags a catch to the arrangement. The report does not detail specific lenders, rates, or terms.
stories.whyItMatters: Readers weighing Bitcoin-backed credit instead of selling need to understand the tradeoffs, especially liquidation risk if prices fall.
whatToWatch: Details on which lenders offer this and under what terms
Any regulatory scrutiny of Bitcoin-backed lending products
questions: What exactly is the catch — rates, custody terms, or liquidation risk?
Which lenders or platforms are involved?

sources.title: You can borrow against Bitcoin without selling it, but there’s a catch

stories.title: Bitcoin tests $78.3K support as oil climbs and stock-correlation debate resurfaces
stories.summary: Bitcoin is testing a key support level near $78,300 as US crude oil hit a three-month high, Cointelegraph reports. Separately, CryptoSlate notes Bitcoin's correlation with the S&P 500 fell to a decade low, though it cautions that daily data tells a more complicated story.
stories.whyItMatters: Support levels and Bitcoin's shifting correlation with stocks shape how traders and allocators size crypto risk against traditional markets.
whatToWatch: Whether the $78.3K support level holds
Continued moves in oil prices
Further data on the Bitcoin-S&P 500 correlation trend
questions: Does the low correlation reading hold up over time, or is it a short-term anomaly?

sources.title: Bitcoin just hit a decade-low S&P 500 correlation, but the daily data tells a different story
Bitcoin faces key support test at $78.3K as US crude oil hits three-month high

stories.title: U.S. Bank tests its own stablecoin in cross-border Stellar transaction
stories.summary: U.S. Bank has tested a proprietary stablecoin in a cross-border transaction on the Stellar network, according to Cointelegraph. The move signals continued bank interest in blockchain rails for international settlement.
stories.whyItMatters: A major US bank piloting its own stablecoin on a public blockchain is a concrete sign of institutional stablecoin adoption beyond crypto-native issuers.
whatToWatch: Whether the pilot moves toward broader production use
Other banks announcing similar stablecoin trials
Regulatory guidance on bank-issued stablecoins
questions: What scale or customer base is planned for this stablecoin?

sources.title: U.S. Bank tests proprietary stablecoin in cross-border Stellar transaction

stories.title: Bitcoin fails to reclaim $80K as yen strengthens near 153 per dollar
stories.summary: Bitcoin failed to retake the $80,000 level, with Cointelegraph tying the move to yen strength around 153 per dollar following comments from Treasury Secretary Bessent.
stories.whyItMatters: The move shows Bitcoin's continued sensitivity to currency markets and US Treasury commentary, not just crypto-specific news.
whatToWatch: Whether $80K holds as resistance
Further yen movement
Additional comments from Bessent
questions: How durable is the yen-driven pressure on Bitcoin and other risk assets?

sources.title: Bitcoin fails to reclaim $80K as Bessent fuels yen strength around 153 per dollar

stories.title: Ethereum's institutional staking grows, but Lido's share keeps shrinking
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that institutional staking of Ethereum continues to expand, even as liquid-staking leader Lido sees its share of that market decline.
stories.whyItMatters: A shift in staking market share points to growing competition among providers as more institutions lock up ETH.
whatToWatch: Which providers are gaining the share Lido is losing
Whether Lido changes its product or fee structure in response
questions: What is driving institutions toward competitors over Lido?

sources.title: Ethereum’s institutional staking boom is growing, but Lido’s share is shrinking

stories.title: Consensys to split, spinning MetaMask off as its own company
stories.summary: Consensys is splitting into two entities, with MetaMask separating from its parent company, according to Decrypt.
stories.whyItMatters: MetaMask is one of the most widely used crypto wallets, so a corporate split could affect its roadmap, funding, and governance.
whatToWatch: Details on the new corporate structure and leadership
Any funding or token implications for MetaMask
What happens to Consensys's other products
questions: Why is the split happening now?

sources.title: Consensys Is Splitting in Two as MetaMask Goes Its Own Way

stories.title: Jack Dorsey's Block seeks US trust bank charter for Bitcoin and stablecoin business
stories.summary: Block, the fintech company led by Jack Dorsey, is seeking a US trust bank charter to support its Bitcoin and stablecoin operations, Cointelegraph reports.
stories.whyItMatters: A trust charter would let a major fintech custody and operate crypto services under a federal banking framework, marking a notable step in bank-fintech-crypto convergence.
whatToWatch: The regulator's decision on Block's charter application
Timeline for approval
Scope of activities the charter would cover
questions: Which regulator is reviewing the application, and what conditions might it attach?

sources.title: Jack Dorsey’s Block seeks US trust bank charter for Bitcoin, stablecoin

stories.title: Tether's $45M freeze push drives Southeast Asian scam networks to an 'unfreezable' stablecoin
stories.summary: CryptoSlate reports that Tether's crackdown, which froze $45 million linked to Southeast Asian scam compounds, has pushed those operations toward a decentralized stablecoin that no single issuer can freeze.
stories.whyItMatters: It shows how issuer-level enforcement against illicit stablecoin use can simply redirect bad actors to alternatives that are harder to control.
whatToWatch: Which decentralized stablecoin is gaining adoption among these networks
Any law-enforcement or regulatory response targeting it
questions: Can authorities meaningfully act against a stablecoin with no central issuer to compel?

sources.title: How Tether’s $45 million crackdown drove Southeast Asian scam compounds into an ‘unfreezable’ decentralized stablecoin

stories.title: Secret Service freezes $52.8 million in crypto linked to Telegram scam marketplace
stories.summary: The US Secret Service has frozen $52.8 million in crypto tied to a Telegram-based marketplace accused of facilitating scams globally, according to Decrypt.
stories.whyItMatters: It's a large law-enforcement action against crypto-enabled scam infrastructure, showing growing US enforcement capability in this area.
whatToWatch: Any arrests or charges tied to the marketplace
Whether frozen funds are returned to victims
questions: Who operated the marketplace, and how many victims does it involve?

sources.title: Secret Service Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto Tied to Telegram Bazaar Behind Global Scams

stories.title: TRM Labs valuation doubles to $2 billion in new funding round
stories.summary: Blockchain analytics firm TRM Labs raised a Series C round that doubled its valuation to $2 billion, Cointelegraph reports.
stories.whyItMatters: The rising valuation for a compliance and analytics firm reflects strong demand for crypto crime-tracking tools amid intensifying enforcement.
whatToWatch: How TRM Labs deploys the new capital
Competitive response from rivals such as Chainalysis
questions: Who led the round, and what is driving the company's growth?

sources.title: TRM Labs doubles valuation to $2B in Series C expansion

stories.title: Mexican musician and family killed over Bitcoin cold wallet reportedly holding millions
stories.summary: A Mexican musician and family members were killed in an attack reportedly linked to a Bitcoin cold wallet believed to hold millions of dollars, Decrypt reports.
stories.whyItMatters: The case is a stark reminder that large self-custodied crypto holdings carry real physical-security risk, not just market risk.
whatToWatch: Any arrests or updates from investigators
Confirmation of the wallet's actual contents
questions: How did attackers learn of the holdings?
Is the wallet's contents still secure or already moved?

sources.title: Mexican Musician and Family Killed Over Bitcoin Cold Wallet Believed to Hold Millions

stories.title: Hunter Biden laptop controversy gets a memecoin afterlife
stories.summary: Cointelegraph reports that a memecoin has emerged referencing the Hunter Biden laptop controversy, the latest instance of a news event being turned into a speculative token.
stories.whyItMatters: Politically themed memecoins built on news cycles carry high speculative and reputational risk and typically have no connection to the events or people they reference.
whatToWatch: Whether the token sees meaningful trading activity or fades quickly
Any statement disclaiming affiliation from parties connected to the underlying story
questions: Is there any legitimate affiliation, or is this purely opportunistic branding?

sources.title: Hunter Biden’s laptop controversy gets a memecoin afterlife
